selection_protocol: All 5 retrieval configurations were evaluated strictly on the 23 answerable dev questions (Q001-Q023) using identical corpus (A_900, 206 chunks), embedding model (paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, 384d), and hit definition. The winning configuration (dev-5-hybrid-rerank-k4-b3600) was locked before running on the held-out test split (Q024-Q030).

error_analysis_1_context_budget_starvati.symptom: In dev-1-baseline-tfidf, dev-2-dense-pgvector, and dev-3-lexical-bm25, Evidence Hit@3 was 10/23 to 12/23 (43.5%-52.2%), but Context Evidence Rate collapsed to only 2/23 or 3/23 (8.7%-13.0%).
error_analysis_1_context_budget_starvati.root_cause: Day 6 strategy_a.jsonl uses 900-character fixed-size chunks. When pack_context formats a chunk as '[chunk_id | source | page N]\ntext', a 900-char chunk becomes ~970 characters, which exceeds budget=800 and is silently skipped!
error_analysis_1_context_budget_starvati.fix_and_impact: Raised context budget from 800 to 3200 chars in Improvement 1 (dev-4-hybrid-rrf-b3200) and combined Dense+BM25 via RRF. Context Evidence Rate jumped from 2/23 (8.7%) to 14/23 (60.9%), and Evidence Hit@3 rose from 12/23 (52.2%) to 14/23 (60.9%).

error_analysis_2_metadata_key_and_defini.symptom: Section-scoped queries (e.g., Q004, Q011, Q017, Q022) and short definitional queries (e.g., Q007 'What is predatory pricing?', Q022 'In section 10.2, what is a cartel?', Q023 'What is game theory?') either returned 0 chunks when filtering on metadata.section_id or ranked narrative mentions above the exact Key Terms / glossary definitions.
error_analysis_2_metadata_key_and_defini.root_cause: 1) In Day 6 strategy_a.jsonl, section identifiers are stored under metadata.section_id_at_start and embedded in metadata.headings rather than metadata.section_id. 2) Dense cosine similarity scores narrative paragraphs similarly to compact Key Terms definitions.
error_analysis_2_metadata_key_and_defini.fix_and_impact: Mapped section_id filter to check section_id, section_id_at_start, and headings prefixes, and added RerankRetriever (candidate_k=15 -> top_k=4, budget=3600) scoring exact phrase bigrams/trigrams, proximity density, and Key Terms/Summary headings. Dev Hit@1 improved from 8/23 (34.8%) to 10/23 (43.5%), Hit@3 from 14/23 (60.9%) to 15/23 (65.2%), and Context Evidence Rate to 16/23 (69.6%).
